props.name: onSuccess
props.comment: Runs after a successful save with the SERVER record, post-reconciliation.

props.name: record
props.comment: Seed values for the not-yet-created record.

props.name: resource
props.comment: Override the ambient resource (defaults to the `<Resource>` context).

props.name: sanitizeEmptyValues
props.comment: ra parity: nullify/strip empty TOP-LEVEL values before save. Default false.

props.name: schema
props.comment:
Resource schema (zod or any Standard Schema) — wired as the default form
validator by the submit pipeline (T2). Typed by what it outputs, so a
schema whose input differs (a zod `transform`) fits and one for another
record does not.

props.name: title
props.comment: Header title. A string/element renders as an `<h2>`; `false` omits it.

props.name: validate
props.comment: Form-level validate fn (ra contract) — consumed by the submit pipeline (T2).
